comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Buried in some of the older comments on this page is a helpful tip. To summarize:

Whenever the Aide skill Seize Cargo triggers during melee battles, it gives you Plunder skill proficiency points. It basically acts as if the battle is over (even though it clearly isn't), and you loot the enemy, getting rewards based on a hidden percentage drop mechanic. If paired with the two Oxford skills Successful Plundering 1 and Successful Plundering 2, then Seize Cargo triggers more often, thus equaling more skill points for your Plunder skill, and thus helping it to level more quickly.

Something I've been wondering about the land battle side of Plundering is, does the level of NPC enemy you're fighting matter as the skill rank grows higher? I'm sure it does, otherwise you could get to R15 just from fighting low level enemies in Europe. It'd be worth testing to be sure, though. Cheers, and great successes in your plundering expeditions.
